ideas.pitch: A multi-modal grid pathfinding and logistics optimizer tailored for pirate-themed route selection.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Grid Navigation - Teams solve a grid-based logical challenge by determining the correct path or sequence of instructions.
ideas.title: PirateRouteOptimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly tackles the grid navigation challenge by offering an interactive visual pathfinder that demonstrates algorithm correctness instantly, mirroring winning logistics routing strategies.

ideas.pitch: A simulation tool for calculating optimal coin bidding strategies and risk-reward ratios in high-stakes trivia rounds.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Pirate Bidding Battle - Teams receive 10 coins (50 points each) and bid for technical questions with 2x risk-reward dynamics.
ideas.title: BiddingStrategySimulator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the exact game theory of the bidding round, helping teams maximize points without going bankrupt through risk modeling.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight parser that translates plain English logic and pseudocode into valid pathfinding steps for grid execution.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Grid Navigation - Teams solve a grid-based logical challenge by determining the correct path or sequence of instructions. Solutions must be submitted in pseudocode.
ideas.title: PseudocodeCompilerBot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the strict pseudocode constraint of Round 1 by providing instant syntax validation and translation to help secure top logic scores.

ideas.pitch: An interactive grid explorer that visualizes heuristic-based routing and obstacle avoidance for pirate grid navigation.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 1: Grid Navigation - Teams solve a grid-based logical challenge by determining the correct path or sequence of instructions.
ideas.title: TreasureMapAlgorithmicVisualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents a fully working live demo that clearly showcases algorithmic logic, which appeals directly to judges evaluating technical logic and pseudocode flow.

ideas.pitch: A real-time dashboard for managing coin reserves, tracking opponent bids, and calculating expected value during the bidding battle.
ideas.problem_statement: Round 2: Pirate Bidding Battle - Teams receive 10 coins (50 points each) and bid for technical questions. Bids must be placed in multiples of 50.
ideas.title: CaptainTriviasRiskTracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Gives teams an unfair strategic advantage during the high-pressure bidding round by removing mental math errors under time constraints.
